    • pillRow

      public static javafx.scene.layout.HBox pillRow(javafx.scene.control.ToggleGroup group, List<String> labels, List<?> values)
      A row of joined toggle buttons, using Modena's built-in pill style classes. The row always keeps one button selected.
      Parameters:
      group - the group the buttons join
      labels - the text of each button, left to right
      values - the user data of each button, in the same order as labels
      Returns:
      the row of buttons
